Row.Text: Gives the Automate Exploration action to every military unit on land and at sea, not just Scouts, so any of them can be sent off to reveal the map on its own. Covers base-game, DLC and Independent Powers units, and units added by later updates. Civilian units, Commanders and aircraft keep their usual actions. Safe to add to a game in progress.
Every military unit on land and at sea can use the [B]Automate Exploration[/B] action, not just Scouts. A unit set to explore moves on its own each turn into territory you have not seen yet.
It stops exploring when a Discovery is nearby or when it moves into the Zone of Control of an enemy unit.
[BLIST][LI]Land military units: infantry, ranged, cavalry and siege.[LI]Naval units.[LI]Unique Units, including those from DLC.[/LIST]

Settlers, Migrants, Merchants and other civilian units, and Commanders, gain the action only when Civilian Units is turned on in Options > Add-ons. Aircraft never do. Scouts and any other unit that already has it keep it.
Select a unit and choose [B]Automate Exploration[/B] from its actions. If it is not available, move the unit to safer ground and try again.
Scouts and other recon units can use Automate Exploration. Turn off to remove the action from their unit panel.
Infantry, ranged, cavalry and siege units can use Automate Exploration. Turn off to remove the action from their unit panel.
Naval units can use Automate Exploration. Turn off to remove the action from their unit panel.
Settlers, Migrants, Merchants, Missionaries, Great People, Commanders and other units that do not fight can use Automate Exploration. Off unless you turn it on.
Show the units in this group to turn Automate Exploration on or off for each one.
This unit can use Automate Exploration. Its group's setting comes first: while the group is off, so is this unit.
